title: 水庫抽泥疏浚
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways
summary: 本課以串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程為主線，先用測深網格與挖方與乾質量與孔隙界定水力與構造條件，再將管徑流速與沉積、沉澱面積與表面負荷連結到復測容積與淨成效。以指定泥漿均質近似與乾質量帳示意，實際泵送、沉降及環境限制需現地試驗。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management through Bathymetric grid and excavation volume and Dry mass and porosity, then connects Pipe diameter velocity and deposition and Settling area and surface loading to Resurveyed capacity and net benefit. Specified homogeneous-slurry and dry-mass examples illustrate bookkeeping; pumping settling and environmental limits require field testing. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測深網格與挖方」與「乾質量與孔隙」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume" and "Dry mass and porosity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測深網格與挖方：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bathymetric grid and excavation volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測深網格與挖方」如何影響水庫抽泥疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 疏浚量以現況與目標底面的差積分，需使用一致水平座標及高程基準。網格平均深度乘面積適用明定分區，陡坡與邊界需更細解析；測量潮位或庫水位補償錯誤可能使整區出現假挖方，應先處理基準再計量。 驗證時應以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折，並辨識以下失效情境：整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測深網格與挖方」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dredging volume integrates the difference between existing and target beds in a common coordinate and elevation system. Cell-average thickness works for defined zones, while slopes and edges require finer resolution. Incorrect water-level correction can create false volume across the whole area, so establish datums first. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「網格越多就自動消除高程基準偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More survey cells automatically eliminate vertical-datum bias" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測深網格與挖方」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測深網格與挖方
knowledge.text: 疏浚量以現況與目標底面的差積分，需使用一致水平座標及高程基準。網格平均深度乘面積適用明定分區，陡坡與邊界需更細解析；測量潮位或庫水位補償錯誤可能使整區出現假挖方，應先處理基準再計量。
knowledge.textEn: Dredging volume integrates the difference between existing and target beds in a common coordinate and elevation system. Cell-average thickness works for defined zones, while slopes and edges require finer resolution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：網格越多就自動消除高程基準偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More survey cells automatically eliminate vertical-datum bias Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測深網格與挖方」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume" is correct?
options: 網格越多就自動消除高程基準偏差
疏浚量以現況與目標底面的差積分，需使用一致水平座標及高程基準。
原位體積與泵送泥漿體積永遠完全相等
optionsEn: More survey cells automatically eliminate vertical-datum bias
Dredging volume integrates the difference between existing and target beds in a common coordinate and elevation system.
In-situ excavation volume always equals pumped slurry volume
quiz.explanation: 疏浚量以現況與目標底面的差積分，需使用一致水平座標及高程基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dredging volume integrates the difference between existing and target beds in a common coordinate and elevation system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測深網格與挖方：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bathymetric grid and excavation volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測深網格與挖方」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測深網格與挖方」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume", which statement holds?
options: 泵的總流量就是固體泥砂的移除流量
清水泵曲線在任何含砂濃度下完全不變
原創教學假設：surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3。
optionsEn: Total pump flow equals the removed solid-sediment flow
A clear-water pump curve stays unchanged at every solids concentration
Original teaching assumptions: surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測深網格與挖方：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bathymetric grid and excavation volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測深網格與挖方」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測深網格與挖方」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume"?
options: 以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
泥餅重量就是已移除的乾固體重量
optionsEn: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Cake mass equals the mass of dry solids removed
quiz.explanation: 以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測深網格與挖方：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bathymetric grid and excavation volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測深網格與挖方」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方。診斷時應採取以下查核：以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. Diagnose it by the following check: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「網格越多就自動消除高程基準偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More survey cells automatically eliminate vertical-datum bias" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方。診斷時應採取以下查核：以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. Diagnose it by the following check: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測深網格與挖方」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方。
原位體積與泵送泥漿體積永遠完全相等
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume.
In-situ excavation volume always equals pumped slurry volume
quiz.explanation: 整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 乾質量與孔隙：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dry mass and porosity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乾質量與孔隙」如何影響水庫抽泥疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dry mass and porosity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原位沉積物含有孔隙水，原位體積、固體體積與排出泥漿體積不能混用。乾密度乘原位體積可估乾砂質量，但需代表性的分層樣本；含水量和壓密隨深度變化，單一表層密度不能代表整個開挖厚度。 驗證時應分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性，並辨識以下失效情境：把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾質量與孔隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In-situ deposits contain pore water, so bed volume, solid volume and pumped slurry volume differ. Dry bulk density converts in-situ volume to dry mass only with representative stratified samples. Water content and consolidation vary with depth; one surface density cannot represent the full excavation thickness. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dry mass and porosity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原位體積與泵送泥漿體積永遠完全相等」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In-situ excavation volume always equals pumped slurry volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乾質量與孔隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dry mass and porosity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 乾質量與孔隙
knowledge.text: 原位沉積物含有孔隙水，原位體積、固體體積與排出泥漿體積不能混用。乾密度乘原位體積可估乾砂質量，但需代表性的分層樣本；含水量和壓密隨深度變化，單一表層密度不能代表整個開挖厚度。
knowledge.textEn: In-situ deposits contain pore water, so bed volume, solid volume and pumped slurry volume differ. Dry bulk density converts in-situ volume to dry mass only with representative stratified samples.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：原位體積與泵送泥漿體積永遠完全相等 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: In-situ excavation volume always equals pumped slurry volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「乾質量與孔隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dry mass and porosity" is correct?
options: 原位體積與泵送泥漿體積永遠完全相等
固體質量百分比與體積百分比可以直接互換
原位沉積物含有孔隙水，原位體積、固體體積與排出泥漿體積不能混用。
optionsEn: In-situ excavation volume always equals pumped slurry volume
Solids mass percentage and volume percentage are directly interchangeable
In-situ deposits contain pore water, so bed volume, solid volume and pumped slurry volume differ.
quiz.explanation: 原位沉積物含有孔隙水，原位體積、固體體積與排出泥漿體積不能混用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In-situ deposits contain pore water, so bed volume, solid volume and pumped slurry volume differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 乾質量與孔隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dry mass and porosity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「乾質量與孔隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dry mass and porosity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「乾質量與孔隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dry mass and porosity", which statement holds?

只要管內有流動就不可能發生泥砂沉積
沉澱池面積足夠就保證所有顆粒完全沉降
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t.
Any pipe flow makes sediment deposition impossible
Adequate nominal basin area guarantees complete settling of every particle
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 乾質量與孔隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dry mass and porosity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「乾質量與孔隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dry mass and porosity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「乾質量與孔隙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dry mass and porosity"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性。
瞬間濃度低就保證整場回流泥砂量很少
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness.
A low instantaneous concentration guarantees a small total return load
quiz.explanation: 分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 乾質量與孔隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dry mass and porosity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「乾質量與孔隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dry mass and porosity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體。診斷時應採取以下查核：分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原位體積與泵送泥漿體積永遠完全相等」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In-situ excavation volume always equals pumped slurry volume" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體。診斷時應採取以下查核：分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「乾質量與孔隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dry mass and porosity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
固體質量百分比與體積百分比可以直接互換
把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Solids mass percentage and volume percentage are directly interchangeable
Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids.
quiz.explanation: 把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
